* Embedding: Vector representation of text generated by Gemini.

* Similarity Score: Numeric value showing closeness between two embeddings.

* Reference Answer: Teacher-provided ideal answer.

* Submission: Student-provided essay answer.

* Scoring Engine: Logic that compares embeddings and assigns marks.

* Module: Course section grouping questions and students.

* Assessment: Collection of questions.

* Admin: User who manages roles and system configuration.
